skills.name: school-lab-report
skills.description: Create per-task Chinese lab-report draft Markdown with task requirements, theory, formulas, code/file references, generated results, and initial result analysis. Use for the first writing pass before expansion, data-analysis extraction, Word rendering, or final hand-in packaging.
skills.role: 分题基础报告初稿：生成题目要求、原理、代码/结果路径和初步分析 Markdown。

skills.name: school-lab-md-expander
skills.description: Expand preliminary Chinese lab-report Markdown into detailed Word-ready `实验过程及内容` Markdown. Use when Codex needs to preserve original problem statements and assignment images while adding theory, derivations, algorithm design, code text, and implementation explanation before DOCX insertion.
skills.role: 实验过程及内容扩写：把初稿扩成可入 Word 的详细过程内容。

skills.name: school-lab-data-analysis
skills.description: Generate the Chinese `数据处理分析` Markdown section from actual experiment outputs: result images, CSV/TSV/XLSX tables, logs, metrics, and figures. Use when Codex needs to curate evidence, write result interpretation, and provide compact figure/table metadata for DOCX insertion.
skills.role: 数据处理分析生成：整理结果图、表格、指标和分析。

skills.name: school-lab-method-conclusion
skills.description: Generate the final Chinese `方法、步骤` and first-person `实验结论` sections from assignment requirements, expanded process Markdown, data-analysis Markdown, code outputs, and result summaries. Use near the end of the lab-report workflow before Word assembly.
skills.role: 方法步骤与结论生成：生成方法步骤和第一人称实验结论。

skills.name: school-lab-docx-report
skills.description: Build the final Chinese Word `.docx` lab report from a template plus prepared Markdown, code, result images, tables, and conclusions. Use when Codex needs to preserve the template, render inline/display OMML equations, style syntax-highlighted line-numbered code blocks, figures, tables, and captions, render-verify the DOCX, and optionally prepare the teacher hand-in folder containing only the report, `result/`, and `code/`.
skills.role: Word 报告排版与交付：填充模板、公式渲染、代码高亮、图表排版和渲染 QA。

skills.name: school-lab-report-pipeline
skills.description: Orchestrate complete Chinese school lab-report delivery: run or verify experiments, generate draft/expanded/analysis/summary Markdown, build and render-check the final Word `.docx`, then prepare the teacher hand-in package containing only the report, `result/`, and `code/`. Use as the single entrypoint so the user does not need to invoke component skills manually.
skills.role: 完整实验报告交付：总入口，编排全流程并整理 report/result/code 提交包。
